# Machina Vault (璇玑典藏)
> Archival Procedural Horology & Kinematic Gearing Vector Engine

## Overview
Machina Vault is a deterministic procedural vector generation engine for precision horological mechanisms, escapements, tourbillons, and planetary gear trains.

## Endpoints
- Public URL: https://machina-vault.glassgallery.my.id
- Mode Embed: https://machina-vault.glassgallery.my.id/?mode=embed&w=3&h=2&seed={seed}&palette={palette}
- Documentation: https://machina-vault.glassgallery.my.id/docs.html

## Key Specifications
- Seal Chop: 璇玑典藏 (Xuán Jī Diǎn Cáng)
- Scale: Metric Chronometer Pitch Module Gauge (0 1.0 2.0mm MODULE 0.8 / 10:1)
- Formfactor: 3:2 Aspect Ratio
- Container Port: 8092
